results.product_description: Intera Oncology INTERA 3000 Hepatic Artery Infusion Pump, AP-0300H, implantable drug delivery device
results.reason_for_recall: There is the potential for leakage along the drug pathway from the pump through the end of the catheter.

Under certain conditions, the pump may not display a soft limit alert, and will not notify the clinician of a soft limit violation before confirming and starting delivery. This may potentially lead to under- or over-delivery.

Software issue:  When programming the SynchroMed Pump with the A810 CP App in Flex Infusion Mode, the infusion steps should automatically be arranged in consecutive order, from earliest to latest. However, in rare cases, the steps may be displayed out of order. If this occurs, the programmed Flex Infusion schedule will not be delivered at the intended time, if at all.
